active_regression_note: v17 uses DFIT2: no constant; scaled C coefficient DSCALE*RHO. Nested C² fit must preserve this parent unless explicitly changed. Physics owns that test.

algebra.jacobi: Write C=D+E with zero diagonal E. C²=DC+CD−D²+E². Jacobi drops E²; repairing its diagonal with sum(C*C,1)−v² does not restore missing offdiagonal modes.
algebra.nystrom16: V=C[:,I], A=C[I,I], C_hat=V A^-1 V.T. C_hat²=V H V.T, H=A^-1(V.T V)A^-1. Add16 factors to current NP forms: left_i=fm_i*c4*(V H)_i, right_j=alive_j*V_j. Rank16 fit needs no C@probe iteration.
algebra.diagonal: Exact diag(C²)=sum(C*C,1) is available through a reduction of current Hadamard cc32 once that owner is present. NP read comes before the usual cc32 construction; reuse requires moving construction earlier with identical owner/key, not assuming already cached.
